internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 13 occurrences the root surfaces only as a noun (no verb, no participle), inflected for number: plural nujūm (9x) and singular najm (4x). Both number-forms refer to the same thing — stars — and bridge cleanly (guidance najm 16:16 mirrors nujūm 6:97; setting najm 53:1 mirrors idbār al-nujūm 52:49; piercing najm 86:3). The Quran repeatedly lists the stars as a third, separate item AFTER sun and moon (16:12, 7:54, 22:18), fixing the referent as the lesser celestial lights rather than sun or moon. Attached features are stable: made for navigation in darkness (6:97, 16:16), possessing positions/settings (56:75, 52:49), objects of observation (37:88), subjected by command and prostrating (16:12, 7:54, 22:18), and eschatologically extinguished (77:8, 81:2). One token — 55:6 (najm paired with shajar/trees, both prostrating) — does not internally force the celestial reading and is the sole residual seam; the packet's own 22:18 (stars and trees co-prostrating) supplies a celestial precedent, but the singular minimal couplet of 55:6 remains underdetermined on Quran-internal evidence alone.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: njm is NOT the sun and NOT the moon — it is invariably listed as a distinct third category after shams and qamar (16:12, 7:54, 22:18). It is NOT divine or autonomous — always created, subjected (musakhkharāt bi-amrihi), prostrating, and destructible, never a worshipped agent. It does NOT entail permanence — the portrayal foregrounds setting/falling/effacement (52:49, 53:1, 77:8, 81:2). It is NOT undifferentiated 'light' — the referents are discrete, located bodies with mawāqiʿ (56:75) and individual identity (al-najm al-thāqib, 86:3). No eventive/agentive or 'installment/appointed-portion' sense is attested: zero verbs in 13/13, so any abstract 'appear/emerge/rise' nucleus is untestable and unimported.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 55:6 wa-al-najmu wa-al-shajaru yasjudāni: singular najm is bound in a tight two-member couplet with shajar (trees), and the immediately preceding 55:5 (al-shamsu wa-al-qamaru bi-ḥusbān) already closes the celestial pair — structurally inviting najm here to be a low/stemless ground-vegetation term paired against woody trees. Quran-internal evidence cannot decisively exclude this terrestrial-flora reading, since no other token forces the celestial sense of THIS word and the immediate collocation is botanical; this leaves a possible unbridged non-celestial sub-reading on one token, which caps the account at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two unbridged referential classes (homonymy): (A) celestial luminary for 12 occurrences and (B) terrestrial ground-vegetation for 55:6, with no single nucleus bridging A↔B. Rejected as the primary account because reading (B) has zero independent Quran-internal attestation (najm is never elsewhere vegetation) and depends on an external lexical prior the source policy forbids, whereas 22:18 (al-nujūm ... wa-al-shajar co-prostrating) gives an in-packet precedent for celestial najm alongside shajar. It is possible but under-demonstrated, so it survives only as a residual seam on one token, not as an established second class — hence a single preferred nucleus with capped strength rather than a forced UNRESOLVED partition.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Provisionally read as celestial najm prostrating, on the strength of the 22:18 in-packet precedent (stars and trees co-prostrate).
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: Analysts A and C, and the contract's caps, prevail: the 22:18 parallel is plural-long-list vs. a singular minimal couplet, and 55:5 has spent the celestial pair, so 55:6 is Quran-internally underdetermined. The vegetation reading is inadmissibly external, but it also cannot be internally disproven; the honest disposition is a logged resistant seam, not a resolved consistency, which caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE without forcing an UNRESOLVED homonym partition.

independent_verification: Cross-analyst: A and C independently grade MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE citing 55:6 resistance and single-form (N-only) morphology; B grades STRONG only under strict external-lexicon exclusion and concedes MODERATE if any botanical prior is admitted. The convergent honest floor is MODERATE with 55:6 as the residual crack.
candidate_root_contribution: njm names a discrete luminous celestial body — a 'star' — as a class distinct from and enumerated after the sun (shams) and the moon (qamar); a countable point-light (conceived predominantly in multiplicity), holding a determinate position, shining/guiding through darkness, subject to divine command, and impermanent (setting, falling, and finally effaced).

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13/13 nominal tokens (N, no verb/participle): plural nujūm 9x and singular najm 4x, with verse_text and word_refs confirmed against the packet.
layer_attribution.derivation: No derivational family: a single morphological form (N), number-inflected only (najm/nujūm). No verbal or participial derivation exists to triangulate a semantic operation.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: One lexicalized nominal class — njm = 'star' (celestial luminary distinct from sun and moon) — covering 12/13, with 55:6 as a resistant seam whose possible second (terrestrial-flora) class is not Quran-internally established.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual framings (creation/subjection lists, guidance statements, oath objects, prostration inventories, eschatological effacement) attach predicates to the star-referent but do NOT redefine the root; narrative/rhetorical roles are not promoted to root meaning.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Analyst B's celestial resolution of 55:6 was demoted to a resistant seam per Analysts A and C and the contract caps; singular/plural were reconciled as one number-inflected lexeme via 16:16↔6:97, 53:1↔52:49, 86:3.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 55:6:1:3 persists as an underdetermined token: celestial reading most-supported (22:18 precedent) but not forced; terrestrial ground-vegetation reading possible but externally dependent and internally unattested — capping the account at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_cases.reason: Singular najm paired minimally with shajar (trees), both prostrating, with sun+moon already spent in 55:5 — the sole token whose class is Quran-internally underdetermined between celestial star and terrestrial ground-vegetation.

evidence_basis.statement: 55:6 wa-al-najmu wa-al-shajaru yasjudāni: singular najm is bound in a tight two-member couplet with shajar (trees), and the immediately preceding 55:5 (al-shamsu wa-al-qamaru bi-ḥusbān) already closes the celestial pair — structurally inviting najm here to be a low/stemless ground-vegetation term paired against woody trees. Quran-internal evidence cannot decisively exclude this terrestrial-flora reading, since no other token forces the celestial sense of THIS word and the immediate collocation is botanical; this leaves a possible unbridged non-celestial sub-reading on one token, which caps the account at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is exactly one genuine hard case (55:6), grounded in the packet's own collocational structure, but the celestial nucleus holds cleanly for the other 12/13, so the result is a preferred single lexicalized class with one logged resistant seam rather than an unresolved multi-class partition.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal demonstration that najm/nujūm carries a sense other than 'celestial star distinct from sun and moon' — e.g., an occurrence establishing an independent terrestrial ground-vegetation sense, or one where najm denotes the sun or moon themselves, or a verbal/eventive use forcing an abstract 'appear/emerge/rise' nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 13 packet occurrences, priority to 55:6:1:3 (najm+shajar couplet) and any future in-corpus najm collocated with plant terms; and the enumeration frames 16:12, 7:54, 22:18 where njm is positioned relative to shams/qamar and shajar.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether the alternate sense is forced by Quran-internal collocation and predicate alone, without importing classical lexicons; check whether the same referent-features (positions, guidance, setting, effacement, subjection) transfer, and whether the 22:18 celestial-najm-plus-shajar precedent still covers the case.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude external dictionary/tafsir glosses (source policy); distinguish grammatical-number inflection from lexical sense-shift; do not let contextual/narrative framing (oath objects, prostration lists) be mistaken for a change in the root's referent; require independent attestation before admitting a second sense.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If an independent second sense is Quran-internally established, the single-nucleus LEXICALIZED_CLASS account fails and the root must be re-graded as UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY (homonymous/multi-class) rather than a single celestial referent.

reopen_conditions: If any occurrence establishes najm/nujūm as terrestrial ground-vegetation on Quran-internal grounds (independent of 55:6), re-grade 55:6 and reopen the homonym/UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY partition.

If a verbal or derived-nominal form of njm enters the corpus, re-test whether an eventive 'appear/emerge/rise' nucleus underlies the noun, potentially bridging 55:6 and revising the referent-only account.

If further study of the 55:5–55:6 couplet vs. the 22:18 stars-and-trees prostration list yields a decisive Quran-internal disambiguation of najm in 55:6, upgrade or downgrade the 55:6 disposition accordingly.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The celestial nucleus is distinctive and survives adversarial pressure for 12/13, but 55:6 resists a clean unified account and cannot be internally forced into the class; because the core holds while one occurrence genuinely resists, a full falsification PASS is not claimed — the resistance is recorded rather than the core being refuted.
